name: BreakRevertPro
summary: BreakRevertPro is a breakout trading EA that identifies price breakouts beyond defined ranges and enters trades in the direction of the breakout. It combines breakout detection with a potential reversion filter to avoid false breakouts, managing positions with stop loss and take profit levels. The EA operates systematically on multiple timeframes with configurable breakout parameters.
summary_zh: BreakRevertPro是一个突破交易EA，识别价格突破定义区间后顺势入场交易。它结合突破检测与回归过滤来避免假突破，并通过止损和止盈管理仓位。该EA在多周期上系统化运行，突破参数可配置。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是突破交易，当价格突破前期区间的高点或低点时入场。入场条件基于价格突破特定周期内的最高价或最低价，可能结合波动率或成交量过滤来确认突破有效性。出场条件包括固定止损止盈，以及可能的移动止损或突破失败后的反转出场。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金的动态手数计算方式。资金管理方面，EA通过止损来控制单笔风险，但具体的风险比例需要根据参数设置而定。整体策略逻辑清晰，但突破策略在震荡市中容易产生假突破导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is breakout trading, entering positions when price breaks above or below a defined range high or low. Entry conditions are based on price breaking through the highest or lowest price within a specific lookback period, potentially combined with volatility or volume filters to confirm breakout validity. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit levels, as well as possible trailing stops or reversal exits after breakout failure. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or dynamic lot calculation based on account balance. For money management, the EA controls per-trade risk through stop loss placement, though the exact risk percentage depends on parameter configuration. The overall strategy logic is clear, but breakout strategies are prone to consecutive losses from false breakouts in ranging markets.

parameters.name: BreakoutPeriod
parameters.description: 突破检测的回溯周期数

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA标识号，用于区分不同EA的订单

parameters.name: TrailingStop
parameters.description: 移动止损点数，0表示不启用
parameters.description_en: Trailing stop in points, 0 to disable

parameters.name: BreakoutOffset
parameters.description: 突破偏移点数，价格需超过区间高低点此距离才确认突破
parameters.description_en: Breakout offset points beyond range high/low

pros: 突破策略逻辑清晰，趋势行情中表现良好
有止损止盈设置，单笔风险可控
支持最大点差过滤，避免高滑点环境交易
参数可配置性强，适应不同市场环境
结合突破与回归过滤，降低假突破风险
pros_en: Clear breakout strategy logic that performs well in trending markets
Stop loss and take profit settings keep per-trade risk controlled
Maximum spread filter avoids trading in high-slip environments
Highly configurable parameters adapt to different market conditions
Combination of breakout and reversion filter reduces false breakout risk
cons: 震荡行情中容易遭受连续假突破亏损
突破策略对市场状态敏感，需要趋势环境才能盈利
缺乏多时间框架确认，可能在高时间框架趋势相反时入场
固定止损止盈未考虑市场波动率变化
缺乏仓位加码或突破确认后的二次入场机制
cons_en: Susceptible to consecutive losses from false breakouts in ranging markets
Breakout strategy is sensitive to market regime and needs trending conditions to profit
Lacks multi-timeframe confirmation, may enter against higher timeframe trend
Fixed stop loss and take profit don't account for market volatility changes
Lacks position scaling or secondary entry mechanism after breakout confirmation
improvements: 增加多时间框架趋势过滤，仅在主趋势方向突破时入场
引入ATR动态止损止盈，根据市场波动率调整出场点
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe trend filter to only trade breakouts in the direction of the main trend
Introduce ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit to adjust exit levels based on market volatility

risk_points: 突破策略在震荡市中假突破风险较高
固定止损未考虑市场波动率，可能在高波动时止损过小
缺乏最大持仓或日内亏损限制
risk_points_en: High false breakout risk in ranging markets with breakout strategies
Fixed stop loss doesn't account for volatility, may be too tight in high-volatility conditions
Lacks maximum position or daily loss limits

It combines breakout detection with a potential reversion filter to avoid false breakouts, managing positions with stop loss and take profit levels. The EA operates systematically on multiple timeframes with configurable breakout parameters.
